members.name: description
members.doc: Supporting text shown with the group, which also describes it.

members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: The message the group shows, in place of the built-in one, only while it is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation. It never makes the group invalid by itself.

members.name: value
members.doc: The values of the checked options, when the caller controls them.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The values of the options that start checked, when the group controls itself.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the values of all the checked options each time one changes.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the group and every option in it.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the group read-only: its options stay visible and focusable but cannot be changed.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the group required, so a form with native validation does not submit while no option is checked.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the group invalid and shows its error message. Left false, validation decides, so failed native, custom, or server validation can still make the group invalid.

members.name: name
members.doc: The form field name, applied to every option. Checked values arrive as repeated entries under it.

members.name: orientation
members.doc: Whether the options stack in a column or sit in a row. The options take it from the group.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size. The options take it from the group.

types.name: CheckboxGroupOwnProps

members.name: label
